# Synthetic GISTDA contract fixture

`synthetic-feed.json` is a wholly synthetic, small geometry/time fixture generated for offline contract, retention and rendering qualification. It is **not a downloaded GISTDA observation**, has no scientific meaning, and must never be published as production source data. Real pipeline collection uses the authenticated fixed provider query. The public production test must use its genuine returned zero/nonzero result, never this fixture.

## National fixture

`synthetic-national-feed.json` is a derived synthetic contract fixture for the national product and local disposable MongoDB qualification. It is not GISTDA data and must never be published to Atlas as a satellite observation.
